SPECIAL BRANCH REGISTRY.
File No. Y. O. 1465.

SUBJECT

Report re exchange of telegrams between
Ettinger (Shai) & Joseph (Hameur)
pages.zh:
特别科档案室。
档案号：Y. O. 1465。

事由

关于艾廷格（Ettinger，Shai）与约瑟夫（Joseph，Hameur）之间往来电报的报告

pages.en:
1465
24/9/17

September 22, 7.

Sir Everard D. H. Fraser, K.C.M.G.,
H. B. M's Consul-General,
Shanghai.

My dear Sir Everard, Confidential.
On the evening of September 19 at
about 9 o'clock Ettinger was seen to enter the building
of the Chinese Telegraph Office.
Enquiries were made from the Military Governor's
Staff as to whether they had any knowledge of a telegram
having been despatched by the person and at the hour
above mentioned, and a telephone reply has been received
to the effect that Ettinger, who gave his address as 30
Nanzing Road, sent a message to a person named Joseph in
Hankow which consisted of the word "No".
This is believed to be a reply to a telegram
which had previously been sent to him from Joseph and
which was composed of the two words "Please reply."

Yours sincerely,

Captain-Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
1465
24/9/17

1917年9月22日，第7号。

埃弗拉德·D·H·弗雷泽爵士（Sir Everard D. H. Fraser），K.C.M.G.，
英国驻上海总领事，
上海。

亲爱的埃弗拉德爵士，机密。
9月19日晚9时许，有人看见艾廷格进入华电报局大楼。
已向督军署参谋人员查询，他们是否知晓上述人员在上述时间发出过电报，并收到电话回复称，艾廷格（其提供的地址为南京路30号）向汉口一名名为约瑟夫的人发送了一条信息，内容仅为“不”（No）一词。
据信，这是对约瑟夫此前发给他的、由“请回复”（Please reply）两词组成的电报的答复。

此致，

警务处巡官。

September 22nd 1917

Sir,
On the evening of September 19th at about
9 o'clock Ettinger was seen to enter the building
of the Chinese Telegraph Office.
Enquiries were made from the Military
Governor's Staff as to whether they had any
knowledge of a telegram having been despatched by
the person and at the hour above mentioned, and a
telephone reply has been received to the effect
that Ettinger, who gave his address as 30 Nanzing
Road, sent a message to a person named Joseph
in Hankow which consisted of the word "No".
This is believed to be a reply to a telegram
which had previously been sent to him from Joseph
and which was composed of the two words "Please reply."

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
i/c C. I. D.

Captain Superintendent
of Police.

9月19日晚9时许，有人看见艾廷格进入华电报局大楼。
已向督军署参谋人员查询，他们是否知晓上述人员在上述时间发出过电报，并收到电话回复称，艾廷格（其提供的地址为南京路30号）向汉口一名名为约瑟夫的人发送了一条信息，内容仅为“不”（No）一词。
据信，这是对约瑟夫此前发给他的、由“请回复”（Please reply）两词组成的电报的答复。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
刑事调查处主管

F 1465
22/9/17

Ettinger previously received a telegram from
a man named Jo Ts Fu 喬志福 (Joseph?)
in Hankow as 'Tsing Teh" 請答 (meaning
"please reply."

Ettinger sent a reply telegram to the Telegraph
Office at Sept 9 p.m. 19th as "Phou" 否 (meaning "no")
The telegram was accepted and transmitted to
Hankow.
Ettinger's address is shown as 30 Nanzing Road.

来自龙华的电话消息。
刑事调查处。
F 1465
1917年9月22日

艾廷格此前收到一封来自汉口一名名为乔志福（Jo Ts Fu，约瑟夫？）的人的电报，内容为“请答”（Tsing Teh，意为“请回复”）。

艾廷格于9月19日晚9时向电报局发送了一封回复电报，内容为“否”（Phou，意为“不”）。
该电报已被受理并发往汉口。
艾廷格的地址显示为南京路30号。
